notes:
The hotkey puts the popup away as well as up, Keep open is a pin on the popup's hint bar, a search finds a title's words in any order, and a pack can wear a colour. Builds on [v0.2.26](https://github.com/bekalpaslan/promptline/releases/tag/v0.2.26).

### Popup

- **Press the hotkey again to put the popup away.** A second tap while the popup is in front hides it, the way Esc does; until now it only re-focused the popup. Holding the keys down still does nothing more than a single press (the hotkey fires once per press and the app waits for the keys to come up before a tap counts as a second one). While Keep open is on, the hotkey pressed from your work brings the popup forward, and pressed again while it is in front puts it away and ends Keep open, as Esc does. A change an existing user will notice: where a second press used to be harmless, it now closes the popup.
- **Keep open is a pin at the right of the hint bar.** The toggle that sat in the search box moved to the bottom bar's right end, the same thumbtack a pinned prompt wears: outlined while off, filled while on. Clicking it does what Ctrl+K does, and the bar still drags the window; the open hand that marked the bar while kept open is gone. The bar's hints make room for it: at the default width the resting bar shows paste, copy, actions and close, and the preview hint joins from a window a touch wider.
- **Every pin is the same pin.** The Pinned header, a pinned prompt's marker and the editor's Pin button all draw an upright thumbtack; the tilted one read as an arrow at small sizes.
- **A search finds a title's words in any order.** "cause root" finds "Root cause first", as does "rt frst"; every word of a query has to match somewhere in the title (or in its tags), each on its own. A single word and a phrase typed whole rank exactly as before, so Ctrl+1..5 point where they did.

### Manager

- **A colour per pack.** The pack menu's new *Colour* entry offers six named colours taken from the theme (Red, Orange, Amber, Green, Blue and Purple), shown as a small dot at the right of the pack's header in the sidebar and in the popup, so packs tell apart where their prompts mix. Packs have no colour until you give them one, so nothing changes by default. The choice is stored in `config.json` beside the pack's lock, never in a pack file or an export.

### Under the hood

- The code behind the popup and the manager was split into smaller modules and the linter now type-checks the app; nothing a user sees changed, and the app sends nothing new over the network.
